historical_claims.anchor: An infinity-category is one answer. More precisely, the kind we will study is an infinity-one-category.

historical_claims.anchor: A simplicial set is called a quasi-category, or infinity-category in this model, when every such inner horn has a filler.

historical_claims.anchor: The homotopy category of an infinity-category has the same objects, while its arrows are homotopy classes, or components, of mapping spaces.

historical_claims.anchor: For every test object X, the mapping space into the product must be equivalent to the product of the two mapping spaces.

description: Introduces infinity-categories through simplicial data, coherent compositions, mapping spaces, and the homotopy category, showing why a single composite need not have one strict witness.
